tasks.title: Ready to do the ASC steps? Everything else is already done.
tasks.description:
🔴 #26 · Ship 1.0 — the last steps are yours, in App Store Connect

Coral's rec: Yes. Both halves of the prep are now real, not promised: 18 screenshots captured against rc.34 and verified at exact Media Manager dimensions (`store/screenshots/staging-2026-09-05/composed/`), and a numbered walkthrough written (`docs/ASC-SUBMISSION-WALKTHROUGH.md`). What needs you is ~15 minutes in ASC: upload the images, select build 33, paste the review notes, submit. The white-screen bug cannot occur in the native build (verified structurally in `vite.config.ts`), so nothing about it should delay the store. *Misfiling caught 2026-09-01 (cross-pollination brief, "misfiled is not deferred"): this item previously read "say go and I prep everything," which filed MY unblocked screenshot work behind HIS decision. Nothing was waiting on him for that half. Prep now proceeds independently; only the ASC actions — which genuinely require his login — remain his.*
